verdict.rationale: Rollbar ships both access paths the story names, so an agent can pull production issues. The REST API can list items filtered to error/critical in the production environment. There is also an official stdio MCP server that AI tools like Claude and Cursor can run, and the OpenAPI spec covers Item and Occurrence resources, through which stack-trace data is exposed. Missing for 10: documented MCP tool list showing issue and stack-trace retrieval, explicit API docs for fetching full stack traces per occurrence, any first-party issue-tracker integration for filing bugs (PagerDuty incidents and webhooks don't qualify), and independent hands-on corroboration.
